verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs describe its own workflow automation, "custom triggers and actions" for compliance workflows, plus automated evidence collection from connected systems. That implies event-driven automations running without a user present. The evidence is a few one-line marketing statements, with no detail on how automations are configured, scheduled or run unattended. missing for 10: documentation of how background automations are set up and executed, recurring schedule support, depth of trigger/action options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions. Monitor controls, evidence, and personnel to streamline operations.
Connect on-premise tools and custom workflows to automate evidence collection.
